note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number exist for both JAYSYNTH ORGOCHEM LIMITED (1193 records claimed, latest 2026-02-28, destinations Mexico, Nigeria, South Korea, Colombia) and the related JD ORGOCHEM LIMITED (75 records claimed, latest 2024-07-31, destinations Turkey, UK, Belgium, South Korea, Malaysia). Note the name discrepancy: the batch entry 'J.D. ORGOCHEM LTD' matches the legal name JAYSYNTH ORGOCHEM LIMITED only as a group/related-entity pair — JD ORGOCHEM LIMITED is a separate customs filer in the same group, so both were checked. Declared HS codes 282110/320417/320419/320611 are consistent with observed shipment HS 32041739, 32041751, 32041761, 32041610 (pigments and synthetic organic dyestuffs); HS 282110 and 320611 were not observed in the visible rows, so no correction is asserted, only that the observed codes fall within the declared 320417 family. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report India sales split) could NOT be verified: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, Google returned HTTP 429, DuckDuckGo timed out, and Bing returned only irrelevant results. Per Rule 4, revenue and domestic turnover are recorded as null rather than estimated. Domestic status is 'unknown', not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here reflects tool/access failure, not a finding that no domestic supplies exist. No rejection grounds apply: the entity is active and shipping, and no liquidation/bankruptcy record was found.
